description: Free, no card, no e-mail, instant result: returns a free key at once, the same as POST /v1/keys {"plan": "free"}, with the same daily limits on new keys per client and across the service. The key is shown once in this result and is not stored or logged; pass it as api_key to check_book or a finance tool. A free key runs 20 own checks a day and 200 in all; without a key it is 5 a day per client address. The result lists the limits. Optional label: 1 to 40 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.

label.description: Optional label for your own records (1-40 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -).

name: get_free_key
